caseNameFull: Duro v. Reina, Chief of Police, Salt River Department of Public Safety, Salt River Pima-Maricopa Indian Community

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1034.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that John J. Trebon, Esq., of Flagstaff, Ariz., be appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner in this case.
